items.title: GM Legacy card hides only its score paragraph, not the whole card, on empty/error state
items.premise:
renderGmLegacyScore() in public/lib/tabOverview.js toggled `.hidden` on the element bound to #gmLegacyCard, which is the inner

score paragraph inside

(public/game.html). On the defensive `!s` branch and the catch block, only that paragraph hid; the surrounding article — GM Legacy header, grade badge, mastery portfolio, persona tier arc and reputation label — stayed visible with no data, rendering an empty husk instead of a clean hidden card. Confirmed via direct read of both files; the frontend renderer has zero prior test references across test/ and tests-ui/.

L2.recipe: Extract the DOM-application logic into an exported, directly-testable applyGmLegacyCard(card, wrap, summary) that hides/shows the #gmLegacyCardWrap article (falling back to the score node if the wrapper id is absent) and keep renderGmLegacyScore as a thin fetch+delegate wrapper; add a focused Node test that exercises both the empty and populated paths against real DOM-stub elements.

L3.recipe: L2 plus a shared card-visibility helper reused by every overview summary card so the hide-target/text-target mismatch class cannot recur elsewhere.

items.executionEvidence: Extracted applyGmLegacyCard(card, wrap, s) in public/lib/tabOverview.js; wrap now resolves #gmLegacyCardWrap (falls back to card if absent) and both the empty-state and catch-block paths hide wrap, not card. New focused test in test/session87-franchise-truth.test.js proves the wrapper hides on a null summary and un-hides with correct score/grade/label text on a populated summary. Full local suite 1,137/1,137 (was 1,136/1,136).

recommendedMoves: Keep hardening empty/error states on every card that mixes a hide/show target with a text-content target — the GM Legacy card bug (hiding the score paragraph instead of the whole card) is the second instance of this exact class found across the audit history; a lint rule or shared card-visibility helper would catch the next one before a session has to.

Resolve the doctor release-authority staleness by running the full staging-verify -> production-promote -> reconcile pipeline against current HEAD before founder-authorized production promotion, rather than treating a fast-follow hotfix commit as exempt from the reconciliation step.

Continue deferring cohort-dependent items (Now/Next TASK_BOARD rows: real-cohort observation, launch-authority reconciliation) — they require actual opted-in users or founder/registry action and cannot be manufactured without violating the no-fabricated-data rule.
